spec_citations.spec_ref: AC1: iterate Mission uses MissionContext.runId and never task.runId.
spec_citations.divergence: A null iterate run id currently falls back to task.runId.

spec_citations.spec_ref: Historic artifacts must degrade explicitly, not imply a false lifecycle.
spec_citations.divergence: A readable spec can be shown as Planned before an unreadable event source is handled.

spec_citations.spec_ref: AC2: requirement source must identify the exact requirement in the opaque document.
spec_citations.divergence: The implementation opens the whole document and attaches a synthetic wrapper id rather than targeting the cited row.

spec_citations.spec_ref: AC3: malformed or partial test counts are never greenwashed.
spec_citations.divergence: Malformed skipped values can still render as Passed.

spec_citations.spec_ref: Explicit NONE is always No requirement changed.
spec_citations.divergence: Rows are returned before an explicit none is handled, allowing contradictory stale ids to appear.

spec_citations.spec_ref: AC2: requirement detail must be readable plain language.
spec_citations.divergence: Adopted descriptions containing Markdown or HTML are emitted as literal tokens.
